name: Workbench P-002 GNOME Organizer native placement
summary: 13 native Organizer assertions passed in a private GNOME Shell 46 virtual seat with fixture PUI. Qualified plan, fleet and canonical goal groups arranged two exact terminals on their existing desktops, left the same-process unselected terminal unchanged and exposed remote, stale and missing failures. The accompanying maintained model/GSettings/GJS bridge suite passed 28 tests. Current-build evidence; installed-artifact three-OS acceptance and shipment remain pending.
